title: Borrowed instrument desk slip
passage:
The neighborhood orchestra keeps two spare instruments for rehearsals. This month, one is leaving the building with a player after the final practice. Ordinarily we put the return date on the case. For this loan, however, write the return time on the [139] ____. The player will get that sheet at the desk before taking the case.

The desk and practice room keep identical lists while practice is under way. At closing, place a tick on the desk list [140] ____ the case actually passes the exit gate. A case collected from the practice room may still come back before the player leaves.

The two spare instruments look alike and their cases are interchangeable. [141] ____ If the borrower calls about a loose key, the repair volunteer can then pull up the correct instrument’s service history without having the case on hand.

If the player decides to leave the case here, do not erase the original booking. [142] ____ a short note beside it, so morning staff can distinguish a change of plan from an instrument that never reached the desk.
passageZh:
社區管弦樂團備有兩件排練用的備用樂器。本月其中一件會在最後一次練習後由團員帶出場館。我們通常會把歸還日期標在樂器盒上；但這次請把歸還時間寫在[139] ____上。團員拿走樂器盒前，會先在櫃檯領取那張單子。

排練期間，櫃檯和排練室各留一份相同的清單。閉館時，[140] ____樂器盒確實通過出口，才在櫃檯清單上打勾。樂器盒即使已從排練室拿走，團員離館前仍可能把它放回去。

兩件備用樂器外觀相近，樂器盒也可以互換。[141] ____如果借用人來電反映按鍵鬆動，維修志工手邊即使沒有樂器盒，也能查到那件樂器的維修紀錄。

如果團員決定把樂器盒留在這裡，請勿刪除原先的借用預約。請在預約旁[142] ____一則簡短說明，讓早班人員分辨是團員改變計畫，還是樂器根本沒送到櫃檯。

The neighborhood orchestra keeps two spare instruments for rehearsals. This month, one is leaving the building with a player after the final practice. Ordinarily we put the return date on the case. For this loan, however, write the return time on the checkout slip. The player will get that sheet at the desk before taking the case.

The desk and practice room keep identical lists while practice is under way. At closing, place a tick on the desk list only when the case actually passes the exit gate. A case collected from the practice room may still come back before the player leaves.

The two spare instruments look alike and their cases are interchangeable. Copy the number stamped on the instrument onto the checkout slip. If the borrower calls about a loose key, the repair volunteer can then pull up the correct instrument’s service history without having the case on hand.

If the player decides to leave the case here, do not erase the original booking. Add a short note beside it, so morning staff can distinguish a change of plan from an instrument that never reached the desk.

社區管弦樂團備有兩件排練用的備用樂器。本月其中一件會在最後一次練習後由團員帶出場館。我們通常會把歸還日期標在樂器盒上；但這次請把歸還時間寫在借出單上。團員拿走樂器盒前，會先在櫃檯領取那張單子。

排練期間，櫃檯和排練室各留一份相同的清單。閉館時，只有在樂器盒確實通過出口，才在櫃檯清單上打勾。樂器盒即使已從排練室拿走，團員離館前仍可能把它放回去。

兩件備用樂器外觀相近，樂器盒也可以互換。把印刻在樂器上的編號抄到借出單上。如果借用人來電反映按鍵鬆動，維修志工手邊即使沒有樂器盒，也能查到那件樂器的維修紀錄。

如果團員決定把樂器盒留在這裡，請勿刪除原先的借用預約。請在預約旁加註一則簡短說明，讓早班人員分辨是團員改變計畫，還是樂器根本沒送到櫃檯。
